Compute logarithm using a high-\/accuracy polynomial approximation. 

This function calculates the logarithm of a number represented in triple-\/double precision using a polynomial approximation method. It takes into account the high, medium, and low parts of the input number to ensure accuracy.


\begin{DoxyParams}{Parameters}
{\em logh} & Pointer to store the high part of the logarithm result. \\
\hline
{\em logm} & Pointer to store the medium part of the logarithm result. \\
\hline
{\em logl} & Pointer to store the low part of the logarithm result. \\
\hline
{\em E} & Exponent part of the input number. \\
\hline
{\em ed} & Exponent delta for scaling. \\
\hline
{\em index} & Index for selecting polynomial coefficients. \\
\hline
{\em zh} & High part of the normalized input number. \\
\hline
{\em zl} & Low part of the normalized input number. \\
\hline
{\em logih} & High part of the logarithm of the integer part. \\
\hline
{\em logim} & Medium part of the logarithm of the integer part. \\
\hline
\end{DoxyParams}
